chars.S: SOFIANE: a young man wearing a grey hoodie with one bright yellow stripe across the chest, dark blue jeans, white sneakers.
chars.K: KARIM: a big muscular prisoner wearing a red sleeveless tank top and black tracksuit trousers, many thin scar lines drawn across his round white head, angry frown.
chars.H: HAMID: a slim older prisoner wearing a long green-and-white vertically striped shirt and brown trousers, thin grey eyebrows.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: KARIM walks right up to SOFIANE and leans over him aggressively, face to face, fists clenched, while SOFIANE sits on the floor in a corner looking up, frightened. inside a tiny crowded Moroccan prison cell in Kenitra: old cracked pale-green walls, metal bunk beds stacked with blankets, many other prisoners in plain dark t-shirts in the background, dim light from a small barred window.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close view: KARIM's scarred angry face looming very close over SOFIANE, who leans back against the wall, sweating with fear. inside a tiny crowded Moroccan prison cell in Kenitra: old cracked pale-green walls, metal bunk beds stacked with blankets, many other prisoners in plain dark t-shirts in the background, dim light from a small barred window.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: KARIM points his finger at SOFIANE's chest, interrogating him harshly, other prisoners watching. inside a tiny crowded Moroccan prison cell in Kenitra: old cracked pale-green walls, metal bunk beds stacked with blankets, many other prisoners in plain dark t-shirts in the background, dim light from a small barred window.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SOFIANE, silent and tired, hands a folded sheet of paper up to KARIM, who grabs it suspiciously. inside a tiny crowded Moroccan prison cell in Kenitra: old cracked pale-green walls, metal bunk beds stacked with blankets, many other prisoners in plain dark t-shirts in the background, dim light from a small barred window.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: KARIM reads the paper while several prisoners crowd around SOFIANE in a circle, all questioning him at once with raised hands. inside a tiny crowded Moroccan prison cell in Kenitra: old cracked pale-green walls, metal bunk beds stacked with blankets, many other prisoners in plain dark t-shirts in the background, dim light from a small barred window.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SOFIANE shrugs nervously while KARIM and the surrounding prisoners burst out laughing, holding their bellies, pointing at him. inside a tiny crowded Moroccan prison cell in Kenitra: old cracked pale-green walls, metal bunk beds stacked with blankets, many other prisoners in plain dark t-shirts in the background, dim light from a small barred window.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: KARIM jumps up mocking SOFIANE, laughing in his face, other prisoners laughing behind; SOFIANE looks down, humiliated. inside a tiny crowded Moroccan prison cell in Kenitra: old cracked pale-green walls, metal bunk beds stacked with blankets, many other prisoners in plain dark t-shirts in the background, dim light from a small barred window.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: HAMID sits on the top level of a metal bunk bed and points down at SOFIANE with one finger, inviting him to climb up; SOFIANE looks up at him, surprised. inside a tiny crowded Moroccan prison cell in Kenitra: old cracked pale-green walls, metal bunk beds stacked with blankets, many other prisoners in plain dark t-shirts in the background, dim light from a small barred window.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: SOFIANE has just climbed onto the top bunk next to HAMID; HAMID stares at him wide-eyed, recognizing him, and SOFIANE freezes in shock. inside a tiny crowded Moroccan prison cell in Kenitra: old cracked pale-green walls, metal bunk beds stacked with blankets, many other prisoners in plain dark t-shirts in the background, dim light from a small barred window.
